description: Askari Bank Limited is a Pakistani commercial bank that provides personal banking - credit and debit cards, car loans, mortgage accounts and digital banking - alongside business banking through its Corporate and Investment Banking Group. Its Shariah-compliant business, Askari Ikhlas Islamic Banking, operates through 140 dedicated branches offering personal and corporate banking, Islamic treasury, trade services and Banca-Takaful solutions.
headOffice: Third Floor, Plot No. 18, NPT Building, F-8 Markaz, Islamabad, Pakistan

products.name: Askari Zabardast Current Account
products.summary: A current account described by the bank as a dynamic, all-in-one banking solution for individuals, sole proprietors and businesses.

products.name: Askari Asaan Savings Account
products.summary: A simplified savings account for unbanked resident Pakistanis, opened with Rs. 100 and a CNIC, with no minimum balance requirement.

products.name: Askari Sahar Savings Account
products.summary: A savings account designed for women, offering monthly profit payment and no initial deposit requirement.

products.name: Askari GO Account
products.summary: An account for teenagers aged 13 to under 18, offered in current and savings variants, in both conventional and Islamic forms.

products.name: Askari Ikhlas Islamic Banking
products.summary: Shariah-compliant personal and corporate banking, including Qard current accounts, Mudarabah savings and Murabaha, Ijarah and Istisna financing.
